top_findings: Canonical tags are absent from sampled public pages
Some titles duplicate the Prism brand suffix
No social preview images or JSON-LD were detected
Browser-local and private routes are not explicitly noindex
quick_wins: Remove redundant brand suffixes from child titles
Add production-aware robots and sitemap metadata routes
Set noindex on private and browser-only routes

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 33 discovered internal homepage links returned HTTP 200

findings.title: Robots and sitemap endpoints are missing
findings.recommendation: Add production-aware robots.ts and sitemap.ts routes and verify their production output.

findings.title: Canonical URLs are absent
findings.description: The homepage, sampled article, profile, and topic pages rendered without a canonical link.
findings.recommendation: Set absolute canonical URLs for all indexable pages using the production origin.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Sampled public pages have page-specific descriptions and useful H1 headings.

findings.title: Legal page descriptions are marked as demo placeholders
findings.description: Terms, Privacy, and Content Policy descriptions include the words 'demo placeholder'.
findings.recommendation: Replace placeholder descriptions and confirm the public legal copy is final and accurate.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage and sampled public article/topic pages have one H1 and unique descriptions.

findings.title: Brand suffix is duplicated in several titles
findings.description: Examples include 'Explore — Prism | Prism', 'Search — Prism | Prism', and 'Alex Chen — Prism | Prism'.
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant brand suffix from child metadata titles; retain the root title template.

findings.title: App pages inherit generic descriptions
findings.description: Login, signup, settings, dashboard, and editor pages use the generic site description.
findings.recommendation: Mark private routes noindex; provide specific descriptions only for routes intended to appear in search.

findings.title: No JSON-LD was detected
findings.description: No application/ld+json scripts were present on the homepage or sampled public article.
findings.recommendation: Add accurate WebSite/Organization and Article structured data, then validate it.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: The homepage had no horizontal overflow at a 390px viewport.

findings.title: LCP candidate and font preload need lab validation
findings.description: The browser flagged an avatar image as the homepage LCP candidate and reported font preloads unused shortly after load. No measured CWV values are available.
findings.recommendation: Run Lighthouse on a production build and optimize based on the LCP trace and actual font usage.

findings.title: No llms.txt or structured data
findings.description: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404 and no JSON-LD was detected. These checks do not establish whether AI crawlers can access a future production host.
findings.recommendation: Consider a maintained llms.txt and accurate structured data after production crawl rules and canonicals are in place.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Sampled images had alt attributes; decorative images correctly use empty alt text.

findings.title: Social card images are absent
findings.description: The homepage and sampled article did not render og:image or twitter:image.
findings.recommendation: Provide absolute social preview images with suitable dimensions and verify previews.

phases.name: Phase 1: Technical foundations
items: Add production-aware robots and sitemap routes

phases.name: Phase 2: Metadata and sharing
items: Add social images and validated JSON-LD

phases.name: Phase 3: Performance
items: Run Lighthouse on a production build
Use measured LCP and font traces to tune assets

phases.name: Phase 4: Production monitoring
items: Repeat the audit against the public production URL
Connect Search Console and field data where available

limitations: Localhost only; production crawlability and indexing were not established.
Bundled SEO runtime was not ready; Lighthouse, CrUX, Search Console, analytics, and backlinks were not checked.
Score is an indicative manual checklist score, not a Lighthouse result.
